name: bit-ops
description: Bit manipulation utilities including power-of-two checks, population count, bit set/clear/toggle/get, bit reversal, and Gray code encoding/decoding.
aiPromptContext: Use this block for low-level bit manipulation tasks such as flags/masks, hardware register operations, encoding schemes, or performance-critical algorithms that rely on binary representations.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: The integer value to perform bit operations on

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Bit position (0 = LSB) for set/clear/toggle/get operations
